Name: Pet Deerfox
Author: sopholophagus
Description:
[size=3]1.6 note: I have tested, and this mod should be compatible with 1.6 when it releases. Please let me know if there are issues.
----

This mod replaces pets with a deerfox inspired by the comic/TV series Hilda. The deerfox can replace any specific pet, all cats, all dogs, or all pets. This is set in the config file.

Additionally, there are 4 color options:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Twig White[/size]
[*][color=#76a5af][size=3] Hilda Blue [/size][/color]
[*][color=#f6b26b][size=3]Frida Orange[/size][/color]
[*][color=#dd7e6b][size=3]David Red[/size][/color]
[/list][size=3]
These are also set in the config.[/size]
